class.name: FmodAudioEffectHardLimiter
class.brief_description: Hard limiter to prevent audio clipping and distortion.
class.description: FmodAudioEffectHardLimiter is a brick-wall limiter that prevents the audio signal from exceeding a specified ceiling level. It ensures that the output never goes above the threshold, effectively preventing clipping and distortion that can occur when signals exceed 0 dBFS. The limiter uses look-ahead processing with approximately 2 ms of audio delay to control peaks, followed by the configured release. It limits sampled peaks; it does not measure reconstructed inter-sample peaks. The limiter can also apply pre-gain to boost the signal before limiting, allowing you to maximize perceived loudness while staying within safe levels.

members.member: The output sample-peak ceiling in decibels, clamped to -24.0 through 0.0 dB. The default is -0.3 dB. Leaving headroom below 0 dB can reduce clipping risk, but this is not a true-peak limiter.
The gain applied before limiting, in decibels, clamped to -24.0 through +24.0 dB. The default is 0.0 dB.
The release time in seconds, clamped to 0.01 through 3.0. The default is 0.1 seconds. It controls how quickly gain recovers after limiting.
